description: Banning all electronic driver aid devies, such as active suspension, traction control, anti-lock braking etc.

Majority of of all aerodynamic devices were banned, driver-adjustable front wings were permitted, slick tyres were re-introduced, engine regulation change to 2.4-litre naturally aspirated V8s.
